links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and comprehensiveness of retrieval-augmented vs standard ChatGPT-4o responses

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRES) of retrieval-augmented vs standard ChatGPT-4o patient education responses
links.effect: FKGL and FRES favoured the standard model over Deep Research (both p < 0.001); Deep Research reduced readability.
